name: Brenna Cavanaugh
source:
Brenna's background is a complete mystery to pretty much everyone.
The only thing really known about her is that she had a falling out with one of the Fae courts and generally dislikes other Fae. Though usually described as 'much older than she looks' no one is quite sure what that means. The rest of the Paranormal Mysteries Club assume that she bangs around the school because of a mixture of curiosity and boredom.
